item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 20/Mar/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will cover the region. The easterly airstream is expected to moderate early next week. The weather will improve over Guangdong. It will be generally fine over the region and hot during the day in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Wind: East force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning. Bright periods during the day.
Temp range: 20 - 24 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
